$comment: Local extension of the upstream SAP abap-file-formats auth-v1.json (2026): upstream models only generalInformation.dataElement and alternativeSearchHelp.checkTable, but the AUTHX maintenance row also stores EXIT_FB (search-help exit function module) and ACTVT_FLAG (activity field). The local schema keeps every upstream property name and adds generalInformation.searchHelpExit + generalInformation.activityField. The AFF header is omitted: AUTH has no text table, so there is no description/language to carry. Excluded from scripts/sync-aff-schema.sh.
title: Authorization Field

dataElement.title: Data Element
dataElement.description: Name of the data element (AUTHX-ROLLNAME), at most 30 characters

searchHelpExit.title: Search Help Exit
searchHelpExit.description: Local extension: search-help exit function module (AUTHX-EXIT_FB), at most 30 characters

activityField.title: Activity Field
activityField.description: Local extension: marks the field as an activity field (AUTHX-ACTVT_FLAG = 'X')

alternativeSearchHelp.title: Alternative Search Help in Standard Maintenance Dialog
alternativeSearchHelp.description: Alternative search help in standard maintenance dialog

checkTable.title: Check Table
checkTable.description: Check table used for value selection (AUTHX-CHECKTABLE), at most 30 characters
